title: TokenInfo
description: User and organization information for a Fly.io OAuth token.

user_id.description: The Fly.io user ID associated with this token.

email.description: The obfuscated email alias of the authenticated user.

organization_id.description: The Fly.io organization ID the user is acting within.

organization_name.description: The display name of the organization.

role.description: The user's role within the organization.
